quizGuardRationale: 跳ねる compares actual jumping/diving, finishing and splash facets; separate 撥ねる/刎ねる identities do not transfer hit/reject/behead senses. 歯磨き includes toothpaste and the brushing action, compared with actual 磨く.

はめる compares insertion, fitting, wearing and deception facets against actual older bodies, including stable kana ID あてはめる. Its source sexual sense requires a vulgar-colloquial warning, not neutral romantic teaching.
早口 compares both 速い and 早い without inventing early speaking; 流行る compares fashion/popularity/flourishing/spreading facets, not the separate impatience verb.

払い込む compares actual paying/remitting/depositing facets; 払い戻す compares refund/return facets, including existing バック's refund recognition. Payment is not always savings and reimbursement is not unrestricted debt repayment.
バランス compares equilibrium/stability and financial-account balance, distinguishing 差し引き's arithmetic net. 針金 compares actual 線 wire, not all threads or cables by category.

張り切る compares energetic/eager/enthusiastic facets, not a mandatory transitivity or cut-related etymology. 反映 compares light/representation/update facets and distinguishes 反省's self-review; English reflection does not merge their senses.
判子 compares 切手 stamp without treating postage stamps as ink seals. Existing 印 しるし is not reassigned to the separate 印 いん family. 半径 has no automatic guard with opposite geometric quantity 直径.
万歳 includes celebration and giving-up recognition, compared directly with止す. 判事/審判 was removed after full-title/person-versus-decision adjudication; judicial and sporting roles are not merged.

反省 compares thinking/examination and remorse facets. 番地 compares address/residence/number facets, not universal street numbering. パンツ compares both actual ズボン and underwear 下着/肌着 facets without imposing rigid pronunciation claims.
バンド compares musical group and strap/belt facets; the bare source gloss does not establish compiler intent. Bund, alumina and unrelated public headings do not enter the pinned lexical family.
